headline: U.S. Prepares for Strikes on Iran as Iran raises highest alert level
subheadline: CENTCOM finalizes strike preparations while Iran activates Code 100, ordering evacuations in Hormozgan and Khuzestan as FinCEN severs MEXC Global from the U.S. financial system.
lede: The United States is finalizing operational preparations for potential strikes on Iran after an urgent White House briefing with President Trump. Iran has declared its highest alert level, Code 100, ordering evacuations in southern provinces such as Hormozgan and Khuzestan. Simultaneously, FinCEN has severed MEXC Global from the U.S. financial system, cutting off over $16 billion in illicit transactions linked to Iranian sanctions evasion.

sections.title: Ukraine Launches Massive Missile and Drone Barrage
sections.body: Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack across Ukraine, including 6-8 ballistic missiles striking Kyiv within two minutes. Ukrainian drones simultaneously targeted Russian oil infrastructure and airfields in Krasnodar Krai, Volgograd, Astrakhan, and Kaluga. Russian forces redeployed over 1,000 troops to occupied Kherson during a humanitarian pause.

sections.title: Iran Raises Highest Alert, Air Defense Activated
sections.body: CENTCOM is finalizing preparations for possible strikes on Iran following an urgent White House briefing with President Trump and Joint Chiefs Chair Dan Caine. Iran activated Code 100, its highest alert, ordering evacuations and dispersal for southern provinces amid reported air defense activity in Qeshm, Shushtar, and Dezful. FinCEN designated MEXC Global a primary money laundering concern, cutting it off from the U.S. financial system for at least $16 billion in illicit transactions tied to Iran, North Korea, and Russia.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The convergence of U.S. strike preparations, Iran's highest alert, and active air defense engagements signals a high probability of kinetic escalation. Parallel financial strangulation via MEXC Global cuts off sanctions evasion networks, potentially provoking asymmetric retaliation while the IDF's 'Orange Dawn' drill demonstrates Israeli readiness for multi‑front conflict.
